applicability: Central review of an invariant for which the comparison owner confirms no recorded family membership.
conditions: A valid selected-invariant read supplies its statement, source attribution and evidence.
exclusions: Confirmed no-family does not include uninitialized, unreadable, unselected or partial family knowledge.
No family is invented to make the central reading path available.
statement: A confirmed no-family invariant retains the same central statement, source-expression and evidence reading path.
